sloka: मम प्राणैः प्रियतरम् पुत्रम् पुत्रम् इव औरसम् ।मया हीनम् अहीनार्थम् सर्वतः परिपालय ॥४-२२-९॥
transliteration: mama prāṇaiḥ priyataram putram putram iva aurasam ।mayā hīnam ahīnārtham sarvataḥ paripālaya ॥4-22-9॥

translations.english: 'He is dearer to me than my life. Take care of him like your own son. He is separated from me. Take care of him in all respects, so that he is not deprived of anything.
